name: from_raw_parts
declaration: const unsafe fn from_raw_parts < 'a > (ptr : * const u8 , len : usize) -> & 'a str
documentation:
Creates a `&str` from a pointer and a length.

 The pointed-to bytes must be valid UTF-8.
 If this might not be the case, use `str::from_utf8(slice::from_raw_parts(ptr, len))`,
 which will return an `Err` if the data isn't valid UTF-8.

 This function is the `str` equivalent of [`slice::from_raw_parts`](crate::slice::from_raw_parts).
 See that function's documentation for safety concerns and examples.

 The mutable version of this function is [`from_raw_parts_mut`].
rules: The `len` bytes pointed to by `ptr` must be valid UTF-8.
`ptr` must be non-null and properly aligned for `u8`, even when `len` is zero.
`ptr` must be valid for reads of `len` bytes.
The entire memory range of `len` bytes starting at `ptr` must be contained within a single allocated object.
`ptr` must point to `len` consecutive properly initialized `u8` values.
The memory referenced by the returned `&'a str` must not be mutated for the duration of lifetime `'a`, except inside an `UnsafeCell`.
The total size `len` in bytes must be no larger than `isize::MAX`.
Adding `len` bytes to `ptr` must not wrap around the address space.
